overview.description: The 21Shares 2x Long Dogecoin ETF (TXXD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long doge, short usd currency. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, net fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Dogecoin, net fees and expenses, through derivatives. The fund will not invest directly in Dogecoin TXXD was launched on Nov 20, 2025 and is issued by 21Shares.
